svg.title: WiMeP pipeline
svg.desc: Wild plants (Oryza rufipogon, Aegilops tauschii) give bisulfite methylome data; 41-bp sequences are encoded as nucleotide chemical properties, GC content, mono-nucleotide binary encoding, oligonucleotide frequency, PSTNPss, EIIP and DNABERT-6 embeddings; features are reduced by entropy-based and stepwise-regression feature selection; machine-learning (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM) and deep-learning (DNABERT, BiLSTM) models are combined in an optimised ensemble that predicts 5mC or no methylation.
